extracted.summary: A partner at a law firm is enquiring about a £58,500 probate loan to cover tax and professional fees for a Chester estate valued at around £716,000, mostly tied up in the deceased's home, with tax due 1 December 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about probate funding for the estate in Chester. We have noted the requested amount of £58,500, the approximate gross estate value of £716,000 and the 1 December tax deadline. To take this further we would need the grant of probate or confirmation of its status, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, details and valuation of the property, confirmation of the executors and their identification, and an estimate of the tax and professional fees to be funded. Once we have reviewed those documents a colleague will come back to you to discuss next steps.
